nodes.text:
HMPV/Human metapneumovirus is not new. Recently, some footage about the outbreak in China emerged and now every Indian news channel is talking about it. 5 cases till now

Instead of talking about viruses in China let's talk about how to prevent it guys. let's be more realistic

nodes.author: RealPYumnam
nodes.text:
Prevent HMPV:  
🧼 Wash hands often  
🚫 Avoid close contact with sick people  
🧽 Clean surfaces regularly  
🤧 Cover coughs/sneezes  
🏡 Stay home if sick  

Stay healthy! 🌟 #HMPV #HealthTips https://t.co/xLyga5kdLu

nodes.author: RealPYumnam
nodes.text: HMPV, discovered in 2001, likely came from birds and has circulated in humans for decades. It causes respiratory issues, mostly in kids, seniors, and the immunocompromised. Stay informed, stay safe! 🌟 #HMPV #healthcare https://t.co/aDtvBhBxPt
